q: What CBAM figure does an EU mill need for iron ore pellets from Ukraine?
title: Ukrainian iron ore pellets: CBAM figure
short: Pellets are a CBAM good, so the importer needs embedded emissions per tonne: fuel for the induration furnace, carbon in any additives, and electricity for grinding, reported separately. Fines and lump ore are not covered, only agglomerated ore.
audience: Pellet producers in Ukraine and EU steel mills importing their pellets

ul: Gas, coal or oil burnt in the induration furnace.
Carbon in bentonite, limestone or dolomite additives.

p: Grinding and pelletising use a lot of power. Report kWh per tonne and the factor; for iron and steel goods it is reported, not charged.
Mining and concentrating ore are outside the CBAM pellet figure. Steel buyers may still ask for them for a full footprint.
